=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:136-143, 464-468; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:136-143, 464-468 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Heredoc classification treats wrappers such as `env` and `timeout` as shell readers regardless of the command they invoke, so data passed to a wrapped reader is retained and parsed as shell.
  WHY: `env cat <<'EOF'\nit's data\nEOF` can prompt for confirmation because the apostrophe causes parsing to fail, even though `cat` receives the body as data; the highest severity was MAJOR, while other reviewers rated this NIT.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:298-299, 583, 595 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `|&` is split into `|` and `&`, but pipeline detection recognizes only `|`, causing a command in a `|&` pipeline to be treated as a background command.
  WHY: A later push can be treated as having an unknown working directory and prompt for confirmation even though the pipeline's `cd` does not change the parent directory; the highest severity was MAJOR, while other reviewers rated this NIT.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py: CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, 8 failed tests | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The CI check reports eight test failures, but the available log output does not identify the failing tests.
  WHY: The test check remains red until the failures are diagnosed and corrected; reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:422-426 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Backtick context handling may corrupt the parser's quote-context stack when nested backticks occur inside double quotes.
  WHY: Context stack corruption could cause `<<` inside a quoted context to be parsed as a heredoc operator.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_strip_data_heredoc_bodies(self) | severity=high | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The manual heredoc parser may mis-handle complex Bash quoting or heredoc cases.
  WHY: Parsing deviations could cause the guard to misclassify shell input, either failing open or prompting incorrectly.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1644-1652 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The heredoc parser strips bodies for the Git parser, but the API-write check and subsequent shell parsing still inspect the raw command.
  WHY: The reviewer could not identify a real false-prompt path through this asymmetry, but noted that a raw command with an unbalanced quote could reach the parse-error confirmation path.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:445-450 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The heredoc operator detector does not recognize `<<\WORD`, leaving the body visible to the Git parser.
  WHY: A `git push` string in a `<<\WORD` body can be over-detected even though Bash treats the body as data; the reviewer notes this is a documented limitation, not a regression.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:145, 445-468, 1650-1651 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The heredoc delimiter regex accepts a valid delimiter as a prefix without checking its boundary, so a longer terminator can cause a subsequent executable `git push` to be consumed and stripped as heredoc body.
  WHY: The shell executes the push after the heredoc, but the guard parses only the stripped command and may not check the push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:464-468, 1650-1651 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Heredoc reader classification inspects only the command prefix before `<<`, so it strips a heredoc body piped from a data reader into a downstream shell.
  WHY: In `cat <<'EOF' | bash\ngit push origin feature/x\nEOF`, the guard removes the body although Bash executes the push from the pipe.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
